from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """
    Captures the essential metadata extracted from one judgment document for the purpose of filtering by cause of action.
    """
    document_title: str = Field(description="The official title or case number header of the document")
    document_type: str = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., '民事判决书', '行政裁定书')")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action as stated in the document (e.g., '分家析产纠纷', '离婚纠纷')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
